title: Taco Bell 'Bought' The Liberty Bell 🔔🌮
caption:
True story. On April 1, 1996 Taco Bell ran ads saying it had bought the Liberty Bell. It was a prank, and people called the National Park Service about it. 🔔
Would you have believed it? 👇
first_comment: Imagine reading this over breakfast and believing it. Honest answer: would you have? 🌮👇
